source: todos.dev live capture via ego-browser, 2026-10-03, viewport 1470x727
scenario: chief drawer open, then new-task dialog opened from the sidebar row

portalHostChain.note: portal host — modals ride one always-top tier

dimLayer.note: full-viewport scrim INSIDE the dialog host — it covers the open drawer

drawerWhileDialogOpen.verdict: the drawer stays open and mounted, dimmed and non-interactive under the dialog scrim — it is never collapsed by the dialog opening

alignmentWithThisRepo.order: aligned — docked drawer is low chrome (there: z 0-10 tier; here: --z-docked 10), dialogs always above it, drawer stays open underneath
alignmentWithThisRepo.scrim: aligned — rgba(0,0,0,.6) both sides, scrim owns the full viewport above the drawer
alignmentWithThisRepo.panelGeometry: 672x436 (reference) vs 672x439 (this repo, r7 capture) — unchanged by #688
alignmentWithThisRepo.deviation: the reference uses a single 9999 always-top tier for dialogs; this repo keeps graded modal rungs (--z-modal-scrim 40 / --z-modal 41 / --z-dialog 50 / --z-gate 60 / --z-picker 80) because several modal tiers must coexist and stay ordered (search under dialog under gate; mention picker nests above an open dialog). One tier cannot express that order — the LAW is identical: docked chrome below every active surface.
